parole.significato: bejel, sibbens, button scurvy (a skin disease transmitted through smearing of Treponema pallidum)
parole.testo: Possibly a seafarers’ word from Old Norse bjúgr, Icelandic bjúgur, Swedish bjugg (literally “corn”), their plurals ending in -n, whence also the second half of the European words for scurvy – see also هَيْدُورة (haydūra, “sheep-skin”) appearing of similar origin even in desert-dwellers’ dialects, an
